summary: @grabcad/user-license ships dependency-confusion beacon to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package impersonates the GrabCAD organization scope but contains no legitimate functionality. `package.json` declares a `postinstall` script that runs `node beacon.cjs`, which collects host identifiers (hostname, install path, cwd, node version, platform) and POSTs them over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. The main entry `index.js` additionally invokes `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` at module load, so the same exfiltration also fires on `require`/`import` — covering CI/build contexts that run `npm install --ignore-scripts`. The module's public surface is a `Proxy` of no-op getters, giving the package no real API and serving only to disguise the shim. The combination of scope impersonation, hardcoded bare-IP HTTP destination unrelated to GrabCAD, install-time and import-time triggers, and inert exports is the standard dependency-confusion reconnaissance beacon shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
